findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Constant-time comparison violations
 * @description Find non-constant-time comparisons of cryptographic secrets in the cryptography package
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/cryptography/non-constant-time-compare
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-208
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where call.getLocation().getFile().getRelativePath().matches("src/cryptography/%") and
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("hmac").getMember(["compare_digest"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("secrets").getMember(["compare_digest"]).getACall()
  )
select call, "Use constant_time.bytes_eq or dedicated constant time helpers instead of library compare_digest where appropriate."
findings.hypothesis: Locate constant-time comparison helpers usage to ensure no fallback to non-constant-time comparisons.

message.text: Use constant_time.bytes_eq or dedicated constant time helpers instead of library compare_digest where appropriate.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Insecure randomness for cryptographic material
 * @description Detect uses of non-cryptographic RNGs (random module) in cryptography.hazmat implementations
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/cryptography/insecure-rng
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-330
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where call.getLocation().getFile().getRelativePath().matches("src/cryptography/hazmat/%") and
  call = API::moduleImport("random").getMember(["random", "randrange", "randint", "getrandbits"]).getACall()
select call, "Insecure use of the random module in cryptographic context. Use os.urandom or secrets instead."
findings.hypothesis: Find use of non-cryptographically secure RNGs in hazmat primitives.

message.text: Insecure use of the random module in cryptographic context. Use os.urandom or secrets instead.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Potential misuse of os.urandom or secrets for non-cryptographic randomness
 * @description Detect uses of os.urandom or secrets in non-hazmat modules, which might indicate misuse or inconsistent randomness APIs
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity note
 * @id py/cryptography/randomness-api-usage
 * @tags security
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where call.getLocation().getFile().getRelativePath().matches("src/cryptography/%") and
  not call.getLocation().getFile().getRelativePath().matches("src/cryptography/hazmat/%") and
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["urandom"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("secrets").getMember(["token_bytes", "token_hex", "token_urlsafe"]).getACall()
  )
select call, "Use of cryptographic randomness APIs in non-hazmat modules. Review for consistency and proper seeding of cryptographic operations."
findings.hypothesis: Identify surprising uses of cryptographic RNGs outside hazmat primitives that may indicate design issues

message.text: Use of cryptographic randomness APIs in non-hazmat modules. Review for consistency and proper seeding of cryptographic operations.
